lugs.title: The viewer opens any track file dropped on it, as a static page

attempts.summary: Viewer opens a dropped .jsonl from file:// with no server (classic script, no external fonts), shows turns plus an all-decisions/open-items digest; tests/viewer_drop.py headless browser test passes
attempts.evidence: I ran `python3 tests/viewer_drop.py`, which exited 0 and printed: PASS: dropped coding-session.jsonl: 10 turns, 9 decisions, 8 open items shown. The test opens viewer/index.html in headless Chromium from a file:// URL, so no server is involved. It dispatches a drop event carrying samples/coding-sess
